subject: Full-loop sprint: gating, rotation fallback & scribe plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@gmail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: External Recruiting Coordinator <recruiting@talentbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Full-loop sprint: gating, rotation fallback & scribe plan

Hi Alicia + team,

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood — wed like to schedule your full interview loop as a virtual sprint next week. Proposed structure (attached agenda v1):

- 9:00–9:45 AM PT: System design (Hiring Manager + Senior Eng)
- 10:00–10:30 AM PT: Product sense + case
- 11:00–11:30 AM PT: Deep technical (pairing exercise)
- 12:00–12:30 PM PT: Break / buffer
- 12:30–1:00 PM PT: Culture / org fit
- 1:15–1:45 PM PT: Leadership / role expectations + Q&A

A few asks:
- Alicia: can you confirm availability for the 9:00–2:00 PT window on Tue 11/11 or Thu 11/13?
- Laura: would you prefer to move the pairing earlier or keep as listed?
- Team: please confirm a backup interviewer for the deep technical in case of last-minute conflicts.

Ive attached a lightweight checklist and the draft agenda. Ill send calendar invites once we lock the time.

Attachments: candidate-agenda-v1.pdf, redwood-fullloop-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — Im available on Thu 11/13 for the full-window (9:00–2:00 PT). Thu works best.

One quick note: Id prefer the pairing exercise later in the day if possible, but I can do it at 11:00 if the team prefers.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez

Thanks Priyom — Thu 11/13 works for me. Two quick adjustments:

1) Swap product sense and pairing so Alicias request to do pairing later is accommodated. That gives us: SD, pairing, product sense, break, culture, leadership.
2) Please reserve a 30-minute buffer after the pairing for any follow-up or technical debrief (candidates sometimes need a quick cool-down period).

Also, can we assign a debrief scribe who will capture scorecard notes? If Markus is on the SD panel, can Marissa be the scribe or would Markus prefer to nominate someone else?

Laura
